The new routes, beginning in fall 2026, will provide convenient, nonstop service and expand Allegiant's growing presence in leisure destinations across Florida. Known for connecting small to mid-size cities to popular leisure destinations, Allegiant remains dedicated to making dream vacations possible with budget-friendly fares and excellent customer service. "We're excited to announce these new routes and believe it is an important time for Allegiant to increase travel options in these markets," said Drew Wells, Allegiant's chief commercial officer.
